name: io.github.guangtoutong/unfetch
description: AI-native download manager. Add HTTP/BT-magnet/1000+ video-site downloads, wait for completion with live progress, manage the queue, and subscribe to per-task resources — all over MCP stdio.

packages.runtimeHint: Requires the unfetch desktop app installed (https://unfetch.org/#download). The MCP server is the app binary launched with the --mcp flag; it auto-starts the bundled download daemon on localhost:19543.

runtimeArguments.name: --mcp
runtimeArguments.description: Run unfetch in MCP stdio server mode
